title: Feature Stores: Offline vs Online
interviewAnswer: A feature store manages reusable feature definitions and provides historical point-in-time-correct features for training plus fresh low-latency values for online inference.
why: Feature stores address consistency and reuse problems in real-time ML.
intuition: Training needs historical values as they existed at prediction time; serving needs the freshest values quickly.
deepDive: Feature definitions can feed offline analytical stores and online key-value stores; point-in-time retrieval prevents future leakage.
commonMistakes: Calling a feature store just a feature database.
Joining current values into historical training rows.
followUps: When is a feature store overkill?
production: Use one when reuse, real-time freshness or training/serving consistency justifies the complexity.
workedExample: A fraud model uses historical 30-day transaction counts in training and fresh counts at authorization time.
